note: Code derivation: data/guatemala_2024_homes.do (rename block lines 63-71; Bookmark #4: Parks, lines 386-426) lowercases every column and renames P04A04, P04A04A1..A6, P04A04B to p_p04a04, p_p04a04a1..p_p04a04a6, p_p04a04b (prefix-only, number-preserving rename; exempt from Step 5b). The INE data dictionary (ENCASBA.2024_Diccionarios.xlsx, sheet Hogares, positions 61-68) labels each column, 8/8, and the codes are the questionnaire own printed question numbers (P04A04; P04A04A rows 1-6; P04A04B). Words are the official Spanish questionnaire p.3 (checked against the rendered page image at 200 dpi), not the dictionary labels: A1-A6 and B dictionary labels are character-identical to the questionnaire (7/8); dictionary label variant not shipped: P04A04 dictionary reads ¿En su vecindaria hay parques y jardines? (typo vecindaria; questionnaire vecindario). Printed line breaks (P04A04 stem, A6, B) joined with a single space. Structure: P04A04 (parks and gardens in neighbourhood yes/no) is an item with its own stem -> section _1, no prompt; the P04A04A lead-in De acuerdo con su experiencia, los parques y jardines de este lugar: is shared by A1-A6 -> section_prompt of section _2; P04A04B -> section _3, no prompt. No whole-table instructions. Interviewer lines Espere la respuesta. / Lea las opciones. and the skip instruction PASE A PREGUNTA P04A05 not shipped. Options as printed: P04A04 SÍ 1 / NO 2; A1-A6 SÍ 1 / NO 2 / NS 3 (dictionary value labels identical); the do-file recodes only 98, so resp 3 NS (dont know) is kept on A1-A6 (nominal yes/no/dont-know, not ordinal); NS is printed for A2 but no respondent used it (0 in source and live). P04A04B prints bare 1-10 bubbles (dictionary value labels = own number); option_text for resp 1 and 10 carries the endpoint anchors defined in the stem, 2-9 left blank; code 98 NO SABE / NO RESPONDE set missing by the do-file without dropping rows. Skip pattern: P04A04=2 (NO, 5,750 households) routes to P04A05; in the source xlsx exactly those 5,750 are blank on A1-A6 and B, and all 1,136 P04A04=1 households are non-blank on all seven. Route 9 (server-side GROUP BY on the live table, no export) against ENCASBA.2024_Hogares.xlsx value counts: 29/29 valid item x resp cells equal (p04a04 1/2 = 1136/5750; a1 1/2/3 = 832/279/25; a2 1/2 = 1087/49; a3 881/232/23; a4 803/278/55; a5 719/367/50; a6 24/1095/17; b 1..10 = 22/16/27/20/137/63/108/219/131/367) and NULL cells equal source blanks (+98 for b): a1-a6 5750 each, b 5750+26=5776. Live: 55,088 rows (= 8 x 6,886), 6,886 ids, 55,088 distinct id-item, 40,276 NULL resp (73.1%).
